title: The Scarab's Locked Tally
story: In a glittering salt cavern, Mr 6 corners Noxvellum the Tally Scarab, who has swallowed the lamplighters' whole winter wage into its crystal shell. The shell is sealed by a hoard-lock that only opens when someone names the exact number of ember coins in ONE sack. "Guess wrong," the scarab clicks happily, "and I scuttle off with all of it."
question: Inside the shell are 8 identical sacks of ember coins plus 16 loose coins rattling around, 200 ember coins in all. How many ember coins are in each sack?
solution: Set the loose coins aside first: 200 - 16 = 184 coins are inside the sacks.
praise: Splitting the hoard into 8 equal parts was the right plan — the loose 16 coins just needed to come out of the pile before you divided.
hint: The 16 loose coins aren't in any sack. Take them out of the total before you share the rest between the 8 sacks.
victory: Mr 6 says "twenty-three" and the hoard-lock pops like a cork. Noxvellum rattles off into the salt tunnels, muttering that it should have hidden the loose change better.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight in a knight's helmet facing a huge crystal-shelled scarab glowing with ember coins inside, deep in a sparkling white salt cavern lit by warm orange coinlight.
